title: PowerToys autoupdate configured for Stable update channel, installed Preview release
summary: The reporter says a stable-channel auto-update installed a preview build, but the missing fact is whether preview updates were enabled when the download was staged.
next_action: Request the exact preview-setting and update-source details needed to distinguish a stale staged installer from a real channel-selection bug.

confidence.rationale: The updater code gives plausible explanations, but the issue does not yet say what the update setting was at the moment the preview installer was chosen.

judgment.rationale: The current report is missing the exact update-channel state and update source needed to tell whether this is a PowerToys channel-selection bug or a staged preview installer path.
evidence: The reporter says 0.101.2362.0 updated itself to preview build 0.101.2373.0.
The issue has no reproduction steps beyond “this was done by PowerToys update automation.”
src/common/updating/updating.cpp uses the GitHub latest-release endpoint when include_prerelease_updates is false, so the channel-setting state matters.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the exact prerelease toggle state and the update source used for the preview install.

fix_assessment.rationale: A safe repo-side fix cannot be selected until the updater setting state and trigger path are confirmed.

issue_context.summary: The bug concerns update-channel correctness: a reporter believed they were on Stable, but PowerToys installed a Preview build instead.
known_information: The reported transition is from 0.101.2362.0 to 0.101.2373.0.
The installation method is PowerToys auto-update.
A bug report ZIP was attached, but the existing automation could not analyze it.
inferences: Because the stable path uses the latest stable release feed in current code, the preview build was likely staged when preview updates were enabled or came from a different update trigger than the issue text makes explicit.
This issue is related to the same updater/channel boundary as Issue 50317, but not enough is known yet to collapse them.
issue_context.analysis: The fastest way to improve confidence is not another generic log request; it is to confirm what PowerToys update setting and trigger path were active when the preview installer was chosen.
initial_investigation: src/common/updating/updating.cpp chooses ALL_RELEASES only when include_prerelease is true; otherwise it uses the stable latest-release endpoint.
src/runner/general_settings.cpp persists include_prerelease_updates in general settings.
Issue 50317 suggests the same release-channel boundary may also affect Store-facing state when preview builds are involved.

information_gaps.information: Whether “Receive preview updates” was enabled or disabled in General settings before the preview update was offered or downloaded.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes a wrong-channel selection bug from a staged preview installer that was legitimately chosen under a different setting state.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please state the exact setting value you had before the update and whether you changed it afterward.

information_gaps.information: Screenshots of the current General update settings and About page after the issue.
information_gaps.why_needed: They show the currently persisted update-channel state and the installed build/channel visible in the UI.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Open PowerToys Settings > General and About, take screenshots, and upload them through the GitHub issue web UI.

information_gaps.information: Whether the preview build was installed from an in-app update prompt, a downloaded installer, or another update path.
information_gaps.why_needed: The update source determines whether the bug is in PowerToys channel selection, a stale staged installer, or a manual channel switch.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please describe exactly what you clicked when the preview build was installed.

comment.body:
Thanks for reporting the stable-to-preview jump. To distinguish a real channel-selection bug from a preview installer that was already staged, please provide:

**Needed**
1. Please confirm whether **Receive preview updates** was enabled or disabled in PowerToys **before** this update was offered/downloaded.
2. Please share screenshots of the current **General** update settings and the **About** page after the preview build was installed.
3. Please describe how the preview build was installed: from an in-app update prompt/button, a downloaded installer, or another path.

This will determine whether PowerToys selected the wrong release channel, or whether a previously staged preview installer was installed under a different setting state.
